definitions.explanation: Working together in a coordinated manner; linking up or integrating efforts between individuals, organizations, or systems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連携|れんけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Cooperation with other departments is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{消防|しょうぼう}→消防：03241_shoubou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{連携|れんけい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}した→対応：02510_taiou⟧。
examples.english: The police and fire department responded in coordination.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦SNS→SNS：05601_esuenuesu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{連携|れんけい}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This app can link with social media.

notes:
{連携|れんけい} means cooperating or linking up — working together in a coordinated way. It applies to both people/organizations and technical systems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連携|れんけい}する (to cooperate, to link)
- {連携|れんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to coordinate with)
- {連携|れんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}する→強化：00260_kyouka⟧ (to strengthen cooperation)
- {連携|れんけい}プレー (coordinated play, teamwork)

TWO MAIN CONTEXTS:
- People/organizations: {警察|けいさつ}と{消防|しょうぼう}の{連携|れんけい} (police-fire department coordination)
- Technology: アプリとSNSの{連携|れんけい} (linking an app with social media)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧: cooperation (more general, emphasizes willingness to help)
- ⟦{提携|ていけい}→提携：05773_teikei⟧: partnership, tie-up (formal business arrangements)
- {連携|れんけい}: coordination (emphasizes working together as a linked system)
